column3: Documentary photograph, vertical 4:5. Reception counter of a small Mexican business at dusk, seen straight on: a black corded desk telephone and a smartphone lying face down side by side on a worn laminate counter, a paper appointment book between them. Empty waiting chairs out of focus behind. Warm desk lamp mixed with cool blue window light, real film grain, imperfect candid framing, slightly underexposed, deep blue-black shadows, desaturated. No people, no readable text, no logos.
